blacklistabilityReview.evidence: hbUSDT has an active direct holder blacklist on its sole registered deployment, HyperEVM (100% of tracked deployment supply; census circulating supply unavailable). At HyperEVM block 48936035 (2026-10-19T06:14:38Z), proxy 0x5e105266db42f78fa814322bce7f388b4c2e61eb resolves to verified hbUSDT implementation 0x77b13307d6a36511ee7d887ae7ae9eb28e78e690. Its inherited mTBILL._beforeTokenTransfer checks BLACKLISTED_ROLE for both sender and recipient on transfers. accessControl() is 0x0312a9d1ff2372ddedcbb21e4b6389afc919ac4b; hasRole(BLACKLIST_OPERATOR_ROLE=0x2fdc6683bc8d03effec5b41d3834f28bd219e06ca0a6a26fc737e44b1c7889ff,0xbb4982eb413c66b7b0776b13de41c07322a085db)=true and eth_getCode on that operator is 0x. The assigned EOA can grant/revoke BLACKLISTED_ROLE (0x548c7f0307ab2a7ea894e5c7e8c5353cc750bb9385ee2e945f189a9a83daa8ed), so the current control is active without an implementation change. The implementation also exposes role-gated pause/unpause and burn(address,uint256); the assigned burn-role contract's arbitrary-holder reach is not asserted. ProxyAdmin 0xbf25b58cb8dfad688f7bcb2b87d71c23a6600aac is owned by nonzero 0x76613bddb3d89393b4bd70d6894b1c85f6c37d5f at the same block. USDT parent/strategy exposure is additional upstream risk, not a substitute for this direct blacklist finding.
